usedFor: ClearCRM holds proposals, invoices and customers, and Google Docs receives their details through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Proposal” in ClearCRM, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Recently created proposals are written into a chosen tab, so the document stays current.

watchOut: “New Proposal” in ClearCRM is polling, and “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content.
